question: why slus_006.64/field.bin hashes drifted between the 02:37 shop-resources record and the 10:55 shop-string-uv record at identical sizes
answer: generator version, not source: splat/spimdisasm version changes the generated data/bss assembly and therefore the .sbss/.bss placement

records.build: this pass, podman localhost/xenogears-dev-toolchain:current /.venv, same 12:15 sources

slus_006.64.mechanism: .main_bss output section (main_bss_VRAM) starts 16-byte aligned at 0x80058d10 under 1.33.0 and immediately after .data at 0x80058d04 under 1.42.2; retail g_CurGameStateOverlayID = 0x800592C0 is buffer+4, so 1.42.2 is retail-consistent here

field.mechanism: .field_bss starts at data end +4 (16-aligned) under 1.33.0 and at data end under 1.42.2; retail D_800AF5F0 = 0x800AF5F0 sits 4 bytes past the data end, so 1.33.0 is retail-consistent here

code_unchanged: objdump diffs of the two ELF pairs are pure data-address shifts (slus -12, field -4); 1,829 / 4,322 isolated differing bytes, opcodes unchanged
unaffected: member_change_menu.bin, shop_menu.bin and menu.bin hash identically under both generators
